name: Appcircle
description: Mobile CI/CD and release automation for iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, and enterprise applications. Trigger and monitor builds, retrieve logs and artifacts, manage environment variables and signing identities, distribute builds to testers, and automate App Store and Google Play publishing and rollout workflows.

credential_fields.name: api_key_name
credential_fields.label: Organization API Key Name
credential_fields.description: API key name created in Appcircle Organization > Security. Organization API keys are intended for service-to-service automation.

credential_fields.name: api_key_secret
credential_fields.label: Organization API Key Secret
credential_fields.description: Secret belonging to the Appcircle organization API key.

credential_fields.name: organization_id
credential_fields.label: Organization ID
credential_fields.description: Optional organization ID when the API key is scoped to a specific Appcircle organization.

tools.name: get_build_report
tools.description: Retrieves build reports with detailed usage metrics. Fetches a paginated or exported report on build usage, filtered by date range, build profile name, and organization ID. This endpoint supports advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination for efficient report generation. Exported reports are returned in CSV format if the 'export' parameter is set to true. Date ranges are automatically converted to UTC. The request requires valid pagination parameters and ensures the page number and size meet specified constraints.

tools.name: get_publish_activity_report
tools.description: Retrieve the publish activity report. Fetches a detailed report on publishing activities within a specified date range. The report can be filtered by organization name, user email, profile name, platform, action type, and organization ID. Pagination is supported with configurable page size and sorting options. Returns metadata, including pagination details and a summary of transactions.

tools.name: get_publish_status_report
tools.description: Retrieve the publish status report. Fetches publish executions within a given date range with rich filters: organization name, profile name, app unique id / app name, status, trigger, marketplace, platform, version, version code, duration. Pagination is supported with configurable page size and sort options.
